अनिरुद्ध रविचंदर और काव्या मारन के ग्रैंड वेडिंग रिसेप्शन की झलकों ने इंटरनेट पर तहलका मचा दिया है! 💥

चेन्नई में आयोजित इस शानदार मैरिज रिसेप्शन में सिनेमा और खेल जगत की कई बड़ी हस्तियों ने शिरकत की। 🌟

पार्टी में Thalapathy Vijay और Sangeetha अलग-अलग पहुंचते दिखाई दिए, जिसने हर किसी का ध्यान अपनी ओर खींच लिया।

दूसरी तरफ दिग्गजों का जलवा देखने को मिला, जब Kamal Haasan और Rajinikanth ने एक साथ पैपराजी के सामने पोज़ दिया। 📸

इसके अलावा सुपरस्टार Mahesh Babu भी चेन्नई पहुंचे और न्यू ज़ीलैंड के मशहूर क्रिकेटर Kane Williamson भी इस रिसेप्शन में स्पॉट हुए।

इस ग्रैंड रिसेप्शन में किस स्टार की एंट्री ने आपको सबसे ज़्यादा सरप्राइज किया? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय ज़रूर बताएं! 👇

#AnirudhRavichander #KavyaMaran #Rajinikanth #KamalHaasan #ThalapathyVijay #MaheshBabu #CineChaska

ctx.title: Anirudh Ravichander, Kavya Maran’s Reception: Thalapathy Vijay and Sangeetha attend separately; Kamal Haasan, Rajinikanth pose together
ctx.summary:
Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran recently tied the knot and hosted their wedding reception in Chennai on November 21, 2026. The star-studded celebration witnessed the presence of several prominent personalities, including Thalapathy Vijay and his estranged wife, Sangeetha Sornalingam. 
 Thalapathy Vijay and Sangeetha Sornalingam attend Anirudh’s wedding reception 
 In visuals that surfaced online,  Thalapathy Vijay  was seen arriving at the wedding reception in festive attire. In a video shared by Sun News Tamil, the actor was spotted making his way to the venue alone. 
 Meanwhile, his estranged wife, Sangeetha Sornalingam, was also spotted attending the star-studded celebration, making a rare public appearance. She was previously in the spotlight following her appearance at son Jason Sanjay's debut as a filmmaker, amid speculation about her relationship with Vijay. 
 Check out the pictures here: 
 Apart from Vijay and Sangeetha, the event witnessed the presence of several prominent personalities, including Rajinikanth, Kamal Haasan and others. 
 For the uninitiated, Thalapathy Vijay and  Sangeetha Sornalingam  made headlines after reports emerged suggesting that the couple had separated. However, neither Vijay nor Sangeetha has officially confirmed these reports, and no formal announcement regarding their relationship has been made.
